mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_long_term_memory (memory_id, user_id, tenant_id, topic, content, source, source_session, access_count, last_accessed, archived, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memoryId}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{topic}, #{content}, #{source}, #{sourceSession}, #{accessCount}, #{lastAccessed}, #{archived}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = 0 ORDER BY last_accessed DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_long_term_memory SET access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed = NOW() WHERE memory_id = #{memoryId} AND (last_accessed IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, last_accessed, NOW()) >= 1)
UPDATE ai_long_term_memory SET archived = 1 WHERE memory_id = #{memoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_long_term_memory WHERE archived = 0 AND (topic IS NULL OR topic NOT LIKE '画像:%') AND ( (last_accessed IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at) > #{baseDays}) OR (last_accessed IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), last_accessed) > #{baseDays} + (CASE WHEN topic LIKE '技能:%' OR topic LIKE '偏好:%' OR topic LIKE 'skill:%' OR topic LIKE 'preference:%' THEN #{kDurable} WHEN topic LIKE '计划:%' OR topic LIKE '情况:%' OR topic LIKE 'decision:%' THEN #{kEphemeral} ELSE #{kDefault} END) * LEAST(access_count, #{cap})) ) ORDER BY last_accessed ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT memory_id FROM ai_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = 0
SELECT * FROM ai_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = 0 AND topic LIKE '画像:%' ORDER BY topic, access_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = 0
AND (topic = #{topic} OR topic LIKE CONCAT(#{topic}, ':%') OR topic LIKE CONCAT(#{topic}, '：%'))
AND source = #{source}
AND (content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR topic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
SELECT * FROM ai_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_id = #{memoryId} AND archived = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_long_term_memory SET archived = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_id = #{memoryId} AND archived = 0
